% Generator idioms (matlab2tikz style): row sep=crcr, colours defined
% before the axis, scale only axis, at in inches, forget plot, axis
% background. Behaviour V3.
\begin{tikzpicture}

\begin{axis}[%
width=2.5in,
height=1.6in,
at={(0.6in,0.4in)},
scale only axis,

xmax=10,
ymin=-1,
ymax=1,
axis background/.style={fill=white}
]
\addplot [color=mycolor1, forget plot]
  table[row sep=crcr]{%

4	-0.3\\

10	0.2\\
};
\addplot [color=mycolor2, line width=1.0pt]

};
\end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
